title: Spinach Stuffed Flank Steak Rolls
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged USDA/label unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%. Serving anchor: source serving is 2 pinwheel rolls (4 servings from a 1 lb flank); 14 servings = 28 rolls, 113 g raw flank per serving.
ruled_substitutions: Generic 'oil' (saute line) books to the house Vegetable Oil item - the recipe names no oil type and vegetable-oil is the house generic (7 of 7 stores); olive-oil would be an upgrade the source does not ask for. Fat macros are within 1 cal/tbsp of any liquid oil, so the ruling is price-side only.
Provolone line itself sanctions 'or mozzarella or your favorite melting cheese'; the PRIMARY (provolone) is booked, matching the source's own nutrition basis.
